comment: Minimum versions for npm packages that Meteor's own packages bundle inside a
Those are pinned by each Meteor package's Npm.depends and cannot be reached
from this repository's package.json or its overrides - the only place they can
be raised is the bundle, after `meteor build` has produced it.
Every entry is a version that FIXES a published advisory in the version the
bundle would otherwise ship, and stays INSIDE THE SAME MAJOR. That is not
caution for its own sake: a Meteor bundle records the file a package resolves
to when it is built, so a major that moves its entry point cannot be swapped
in afterwards - see uuid under notFixable, which is what taught us that.
tests/bundleNpmSecurityBumps.test.cjs. A package NOT listed here is a package
no advisory has been reported against, or one whose fix needs a new major -
see the notFixable list at the bottom for those, so a reader does not have to

lodash.template: CVE-2021-23337 and CVE-2026-4800 have no fixed release: the package is
deprecated and its last version is 4.5.0. It reaches the bundle through
aldeed:simple-schema, and moving off it is that package's change to make.
nodemailer: GHSA-p6gq-j5cr-w38f is fixed in 9.0.1 only, a major the Meteor email
package is not written against. 8.0.11 fixes the other four.
uuid: CVE-2026-41907 affects the 8.3.2 in meteor/ddp-server and
meteor/inter-process-messaging and the 9.0.1 ldapts brings to wekan-ldap,
and the lowest fixed release is 11.1.1 - a major that MOVED its entry
point from dist/index.js to dist/cjs/index.js. The bundle resolves the old
path, so putting 11.1.1 in its place stops the server before it starts:
error on boot.js Error: Cannot find module
It was tried, it failed exactly there, and it is left at the version the
packages were built against. It moves when those packages move: Meteor's
for ddp-server and inter-process-messaging, ldapts' for wekan-ldap.
